title: 以为罚完就没事？：美国银行12亿罚单，监管借它给全行业立规矩
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: A Catherine away from the earning story, a Bank of America getting a hefty fine, $1.2 billion for money laundering. What were the details of the settlement?
segments.zh: 除了财报，美国银行还因反洗钱问题被罚12亿美元。和解细节有哪些？

segments.en: So this settlement was something that the bank has signaled through a consent order previously, but really what you're seeing from the Treasury and from regulators in the U.S. today.
segments.zh: 该行此前已通过同意令释放信号，而今天美国财政部和监管机构进一步表明了态度。

segments.en: This is both a signal for Bank of America to say that this is not something that they want to see, not just from Bank of America, the second largest U.S. bank, one of the largest consumer
segments.zh: 这既是对美国银行——美国第二大银行、最大消费业务机构之一——的警示，表明这不是他们想看到的情况。

segments.en: franchises in the United States. But it's also a signal for their peers saying that you need to keep up your systems, make sure that you can prevent anti-money laundering, make
segments.zh: 这也是对同业的信号：必须升级系统，确保能防范反洗钱。

segments.en: sure that you are not just outsourcing, which is something that they referenced for Bank of America in this fine, and that they are improving their technology to keep up with and prevent
segments.zh: 确保不只是外包——本次罚款提到了美国银行的外包问题——并改进技术以跟上并阻止
